caption:
From a non-modelling background to becoming Mrs. India 1st RunnerUp, I’m still screaming. 🥹👑

Growing up, people would often ask me, “Why don’t you try modelling?” and I would always laugh it off saying, “It’s not my thing.” But the truth was, it wasn’t that I didn’t want to, it was that I never believed I belonged. I had no modelling background, no pageant experience, and no confidence to imagine myself on a stage, let alone speaking in front of thousands. From being an introvert who constantly doubted herself to standing on one of the biggest stages of my life at 10 months postpartum, this journey has changed me in ways I can’t put into words.

This isn’t just a title it’s proof that your background doesn’t decide your future. You don’t need to come from the “right” industry or have years of experience to chase a dream that scares you. To every woman who’s ever felt she’s starting too late or doesn’t belong, I hope my journey reminds you that believing in yourself can change everything. Mrs. India 1st RunnerUp is a title I’ll cherish forever not because of the crown, but because of the woman I became while earning it. ❤️
-
The TaRo Tales
.
.
.
